title: Reimagine the Task
coreMove: Find the puzzle, choice, or visible progress inside a necessary task so escape is no longer the most interesting option.
sourcePressure: The chapter shifts from trigger interpretation to task shaping, reducing avoidable friction without pretending serious work should feel effortless.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would tell the reader to make hard work fun and skip the specific redesign that changes the task's pull.

hook: Reimagine the Task as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: rare-book cataloger processing a donation box
exampleSpecs.stakes: valuable provenance details get missed when dullness wins
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she turns the box into a search for the oldest owner's mark and logs three entries without opening a side site
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A foxed bookplate peeks from a donation box ledger.

exampleSpecs.domain: restaurant prep cook washing crates of herbs
exampleSpecs.audience: cook who drifts into messages during repetitive prep
exampleSpecs.stakes: service starts late if prep remains pure drudgery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he times one clean basil batch and tries to beat the bruise-free count on the next
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A basil crate sits beside a damp prep towel.

exampleSpecs.domain: municipal grant clerk checking address fields
exampleSpecs.stakes: funding applications fail because tiny errors survive
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she makes the first pass a hunt for mismatch patterns and marks each cluster with colored tabs
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A stack of grant forms is held by a copper binder clip.

exampleSpecs.audience: tuner who avoids paperwork after house calls
exampleSpecs.stakes: repeat clients lose useful repair history
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he records each note as a clue for the future sound of that room, not as clerical waste
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A tuning fork lies beside a service notebook.

exampleSpecs.domain: wildlife rehab volunteer cleaning enclosure records
exampleSpecs.audience: volunteer tempted by animal videos during data entry
exampleSpecs.stakes: release decisions depend on clean weight history
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she graphs one hawk's weight line first so the numbers become a story to check
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hawk weight card sits under a clear clipboard.

exampleSpecs.domain: tailor ripping seams from a miscut jacket panel
exampleSpecs.audience: tailor who finds correction work humiliating
exampleSpecs.stakes: the jacket cannot be saved if he avoids the repair
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he frames each removed stitch as returning control to the garment and counts the first sleeve edge
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A seam ripper rests beside a chalked jacket panel.
